q: How does CBAM handle mixed fertilisers with different nitrogen contents?
title: Mixed fertilisers and nitrogen ranges
short: Emissions are averaged by composition, in nitrogen-content ranges no wider than 10%, under the Commission's rules. Electricity and precursors such as ammonia, nitric acid and urea count. Fertilisers with only phosphorus and potassium, CN 3105 60 00, are outside CBAM.
audience: Indian NPK and complex fertiliser producers exporting to the EU

ul: Direct emissions of the production process.
Indirect emissions from electricity, since fertilisers are not in Annex II.
Embedded emissions of ammonia, nitric acid, urea and mixed fertilisers used as inputs.

sections.h: Mixed fertiliser as its own precursor
p: A blend can use another mixed fertiliser, for example an ammonium salt, as an input. Its embedded emissions are added like any other precursor.
The contents of the different forms of nitrogen, alongside the emissions figure.
